lines.text: 材料家族：不是越硬越好
lines.zh: 材料家族：不是越硬越好
lines.en: Material families: harder is not always better

lines.text: 材料必须同时匹配光刻胶、刻蚀化学、目标层与去除路线
lines.zh: 材料必须同时匹配光刻胶、刻蚀化学、目标层与去除路线
lines.en: The material must match the photoresist, etch chemistry, target layer and removal route

lines.text: Hard Mask优劣取决于整个Stack中的相对选择比，
lines.zh: Hard Mask优劣取决于整个Stack中的相对选择比，
lines.en: Hard Mask performance depends on relative selectivity throughout the Stack;

lines.text: 不存在脱离刻蚀化学的固定材料排名。
lines.zh: 不存在脱离刻蚀化学的固定材料排名。
lines.en: there is no fixed material ranking independent of etch chemistry.
Can be formed by CVD / PECVD / ALD,

lines.text: 等形成，具体依材料与工艺
lines.zh: 等形成，具体依材料与工艺
lines.en: depending on the material and process
Selectivity relative to PR, Target and Stop Layer;

lines.text: 高碳展常用于深刻蚀和
lines.zh: 高碳层常用于深刻蚀和
lines.en: High-carbon layers are often used for deep etching and
Often lies between thin Resist and SOC,
transferring the PR pattern into the carbon layer
Used for particular critical patterns and

lines.text: 更高密度：可能提升刻蚀耐受
lines.zh: 更高密度：可能提升刻蚀耐受
lines.en: Higher density: may improve etch resistance,

lines.text: 但可能增加应力与去除难度
lines.zh: 但可能增加应力与去除难度
lines.en: but may increase stress and removal difficulty

lines.text: • 更高碳含量：可能利于部分Target Etch
lines.zh: • 更高碳含量：可能利于部分Target Etch
lines.en: • Higher carbon content: may benefit some Target Etches,
but Wiggling and Ash residue need control

lines.text: 但污染与后续兼容更严格
lines.zh: 但污染与后续兼容更严格
lines.en: but contamination and downstream compatibility are more stringent
Mismatch between HM and Plasma Chemistry

lines.text: 相同材料在不同Target、Plasma Chemistry、温度和结构下可能表恐完全不同。
lines.zh: 相同材料在不同Target、Plasma Chemistry、温度和结构下可能表现完全不同。
lines.en: The same material may behave very differently with different Targets, Plasma Chemistries, temperatures and structures.
